focused_tests.scope: Fact streams, original fact experiment, attention control and 33 new paired-acquisition data tests; not exhaustive upstream tests.

cpu_smoke.scope: Reduced end-to-end execution with three stage saves/evaluations. Prefreeze source snapshots preserved; not efficacy evidence.

code_review.role: Read-only separate agent; source semantics and matching review
code_review.finding: No demonstrated answer-position, causal-boundary or arm-matching bug; hardening suggestions incorporated before frozen commit.

audit_selfchecks.scope: Synthetic input/logit/source/tensor/pairing corruption and incomplete-download rejection

independent_artifact_audit.scope: Saved-artifact reconstruction/scoring, no training or model inference rerun

gpu_inference_recheck.scope: Same-environment final checkpoint reload; no second training run

final_model_selection: No seed or checkpoint selection; fixed final step1600 primary for all five runs
